# Code of conduct

This project has adopted the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
as its code of conduct. It applies to everyone who takes part in this
repository's issues, pull requests, discussions and reviews, and to anyone who
represents the project elsewhere.

In short: be welcoming, considerate and respectful; disagree about ideas, never
about people; and accept that the maintainers may remove, edit or reject
comments, commits, code, issues and other contributions that break the code of
conduct, and may restrict or ban anyone who does so repeatedly or seriously.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainers privately, through the contact
page at <https://ventana.tools/>. Say which issue, pull request or discussion it
concerns; you do not need to repeat what was said. Every report is reviewed
promptly and fairly, and the maintainers keep the reporter's identity private.
The maintainers act on reports following the Contributor Covenant's enforcement
guidelines (correction, warning, temporary ban and permanent ban).

Security vulnerabilities are not reported here: use private vulnerability
reporting, as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes.
